name: Pokémon Tower (Lavender Town)
summary: Scale the haunted floors of Pokémon Tower using the Silph Scope to unmask aggressive Ghost identities. Calm the restless spirit of Ghost Marowak on 6F and rescue Mr. Fuji from Team Rocket grunts at the pinnacle to receive the Poké Flute.

items.name: Poké Flute
items.method: Gift from Mr. Fuji at his Lavender Town home after clearing 7F

items.name: Cleanse Tag
items.method: Gift from a woman on 5F within the purified resting circle

items.name: Escape Rope
items.method: Floor pickup on 3F near the western headstones

items.name: Elixir
items.method: Hidden item in the southeastern urn on 4F

navigation_notes: The Silph Scope from Celadon Rocket Hideout automatically activates upon encountering ghosts.
Ghost Marowak (Lv. 30) blocks the staircase to 7F; it cannot be captured, only defeated or pacified.
Step into the blue magic circle on 5F for unlimited party healing while exploring.
